_comment: Cross-language interoperability vectors for TransactionThresholdRule (rule_id=banking-basel-iii). Every SDK (rust/python/typescript/go) must implement Rule.check and Rule.canonical_bytes such that running these inputs through its own implementation produces expect_pass and, for canonical_bytes, a hex string matching expect_canonical_bytes_hex exactly. If any SDK diverges here, multi-verifier independence (the whole point of the protocol) is broken.
_note_on_hashes: customer_id_hash_hex values above are 32 bytes of placeholder hex (correct length) but NOT real SHA-256 outputs of any actual customer id -- shape-correct filler so canonical_bytes tests are byte-exact; swap in real Sha256(customer_id) hex whenever a vector needs to represent an actual hash computation.
